purpose: Ranking and worship reward configuration: schema checks, paired long CSV, reversible CRUD and optional shared-consumer guard

literals.text: select code_data,code_num,top_index from qk.game_charts_code where top_index > 0 order by top_index;

select min_zhanli,jiangli_day,jiangli_hour,min_baodi_zhanli from qk.fenghuo_charts_config where status = 1 and next_time is not null and DATE_FORMAT(next_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H') <= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H') and (SELECT count(1) FROM qk.game_charts_logs WHERE DATE_FORMAT(charts_day, '%Y-%m-%d %H') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H')) =0;
UPDATE qk.fenghuo_charts_config SET next_time = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL jiangli_day DAY) + INTERVAL jiangli_hour HOUR WHERE status = 1;
select code_data,code_num,top_index from qk.game_charts_code where top_index =0 order by top_index;

SELECT t1.cid, CONVERT ( unhex( hex( CONVERT (t3.charac_name USING latin1))) USING utf8 ) NAME, IFNULL(t2.occupation, '未获取职业'), t1.zzs FROM ( SELECT aa.cid, sum(aa.sponsor) zzs FROM qk.cdk aa WHERE to_days(aa.Redemptiontime) = to_days(now()) AND aa.exchange = 1 GROUP BY aa.cid ) t1 LEFT JOIN qk.fightingcapacity AS t2 ON t1.cid = t2.cid LEFT JOIN taiwan_cain.charac_info t3 ON t3.charac_no = t1.cid WHERE t1.zzs > ( SELECT t4.min_zhanli FROM qk.fenghuo_charts_config t4 WHERE t4. STATUS = 1 LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY t1.ZZS DESC, t1.cid DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT t1.cid, CONVERT ( unhex( hex( CONVERT (t3.charac_name USING latin1))) USING utf8 ) NAME, IFNULL(t2.occupation, '未获取职业'), t1.zzs FROM ( SELECT aa.cid, sum(aa.sponsor) zzs FROM qk.cdk aa WHERE TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(aa.Redemptiontime) = 1 AND aa.exchange = 1 GROUP BY aa.cid ) t1 LEFT JOIN qk.fightingcapacity AS t2 ON t1.cid = t2.cid LEFT JOIN taiwan_cain.charac_info t3 ON t3.charac_no = t1.cid WHERE t1.zzs > ( SELECT t4.min_zhanli FROM qk.fenghuo_charts_config t4 WHERE t4. STATUS = 1 LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY t1.ZZS DESC, t1.cid DESC LIMIT 15;
SELECT code_data, code_num FROM qk.game_charts_code, qk.game_charts_config WHERE top_index = 0 AND is_mobai = 1

isolation.network: private namespace; no routes or external interfaces

checks: fixed native ranks expose reversible configuration create and delete, including worship rank zero
both 549-character native CSV fields survive form editing, exact numbered preview and submission without 255-character truncation
deletion uses its own preview and operation ID without a hidden upsert
history restores the deleted long pair with a fresh linked ID and server-owned snapshots
a paired restore conflict is visible and never submits a replacement write
existing-only ranking module exposes edit but no create or delete
identity, independent entry flags and native deadline remain disabled; submission requires preview
one numbered preview and commit change only threshold/interval/hour and retain original native-owned fields
native entry guard failure is visible and cannot proceed to commit
schema failure stays visible instead of becoming an empty successful list
preview freezes exact values and UUID before any native submission
lost native response retains UUID and freezes inputs; storage contains identifiers only
another lookup cannot overwrite an unresolved operation
reload reads committed receipt and clears the guard without replaying configuration writes
independent activity can be edited while the original activity keeps its pending UUID
section switch and reload recover exact original preview, with no invented UUID or values
lost cancellation reply reconciles same control ID; cancelled original cannot later write
confirmed missing preview with no native submit can explicitly return to editing
schema failures remain visible rather than successful empty records
permission failures remain visible
clear preview reserves an independent task ID before any native mutation; storage keeps identifiers
reload after a withheld step reply reads the original task and preserves the completed item
cancel preview and committed reply loss retain the control ID; unsubmitted items stop without repeating completed writes
recovery uses a new task explicitly linked to the selected original task
import sends raw file bytes; PREPARED child reconciliation records not applied without automatic retry

remaining: Deploy matched backend/frontend and verify actual administrator navigation, existing-active-entry refusal, read/write/recovery and old-image history compatibility.
Original Windows menus, defaults and import/export remain manual; new-entry web limit of 50 pairs is not claimed as the original-tool limit.
Native component consumption, ranking formula, scheduling, worship and actual rewards remain unverified.
Other work packages, faults, raids, resources and multiple-level acceptance retain their existing unfinished status.
